address: #   Step 1: (flags & 0x55555) * 2  → shifts current-state even bits → previous-state odd bits
#   Step 2: OR in new current states at even bit positions
#   00 = steady inactive | 01 = rising edge (just became active)
#   10 = falling edge (just became inactive) | 11 = steady active
# Downstream reader pattern: (flags & 0xc0) == 0x80 → channel D falling edge
#   [1:0]   channel A — protection_enable control_word bit 7 OR governor_speed_request_state==4
#   [3:2]   channel B — protection_enable control_word bit 7 OR governor_speed_request_state==2
#   [5:4]   channel C — protection_enable mode_bits bit 3 OR protection_control_state_check_1()==1
#   [7:6]   channel D — protection_enable control_word bit 7 (non-governor path)
#   [9:8]   channel E — protection_enable control_word bit 7 OR governor_speed_request_state==3
